imports.name: pbg_bioreactordesign
imports.description:
BiRD reactor transport process (BiRDTransportProcess) coupled to the cell
engine in the reactor_bird_coupled composites (mbp-03).

imports.name: pbg_copasi
imports.description:
COPASI ODE / steady-state Steps + composites (utc-process, utc-step,
steady-state) used for kinetic-model comparison.

imports.name: pbg_ketchup
imports.description:
KETCHUP/IPOPT kinetic-parameter estimators (KetchupEstimator,
KetchupDynamicEstimator) + the ketchup_baseline / ketchup_dynamic /
ketchup_multistart composites used by the ketchup-baseline-comparison
investigation.

imports.name: pbg_oxidizeme
imports.description:
OxidizeME ME-model wrapper (Yang et al. 2019 PNAS / Palsson lab).
Conforms to the cell-side interface contract — drop-in candidate
engine for mbp-03 / mbp-06 comparator studies. Real-solver path is
gated by upstream Python 2.7 / qMINOS install; non-strict mode lets
the wrapper be browsed in the dashboard without the solver. Live
demo report: https://vivarium-collective.github.io/pbg-oxidizeme/

imports.name: pbg_parsimony
imports.description: Capsule cell-geometry primitive used by v2ecoli.cell_shape (ShapeStep).

imports.name: pbg_torch
imports.description:
Neural-network surrogate Processes for process-bigraph. Provides
NeuralProcess — a drop-in learned surrogate of the baseline used by
investigations/surrogate-modeling. Registered into build_core() so it
appears in the dashboard Registry.

imports.name: viva_munk
imports.description:
Colony physics base (PymunkProcess, GrowDivide, Chemotaxis,
DiffusionAdvection, CellFieldExchange, …) used by the colony composite
and the colonies investigation.
